screenshots.label: Curate Your Home Screen

items.title: Minimalist Widget
items.text: A clean, black and white home screen widget that shows only your essential apps. No badges, no distractions.

items.title: Three Widget Sizes
items.text: Small (4 apps), medium (6 apps), or large (12 apps). Pick the size that fits your focus level.

items.title: Popular Apps Built-In
items.text: Quick access to common apps like Messages, Phone, Safari, Instagram, and dozens more. One tap to add.

items.title: Custom URL Schemes
items.text: Add any app with a URL scheme. Full control over your launcher without limitations.

items.title: Drag to Reorder
items.text: Arrange your apps exactly how you want. Your muscle memory becomes the navigation.

items.title: Completely Offline
items.text: No servers, no sync, no network requests. Your apps, your device, your privacy.

sections.title: Zero data collection.
text: No analytics. No ads. No tracking pixels. No telemetry. Focus Easy doesn't even make network requests.

sections.label: PHILOSOPHY
sections.title: Less is more.
text: Your phone's home screen is visual noise. Dozens of colorful icons competing for attention, badges screaming at you, apps you forgot you installed.
Focus Easy replaces that chaos with a single, minimal widget. Black text on white (or white on black). Just the apps you actually need. Nothing else.
Inspired by the "dumb phone" movement and digital minimalism, Focus Easy helps you use your phone intentionally — not compulsively.

cta.title: Simplify your home screen.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
